magicEffects.name: Forge Call
magicEffects._: Harmless self-effect — a token Restoration heal so the effect actually runs (OnEffectStart fires on the caster). The gameplay payload is the attached MFSE_SpellTrigger script, not the heal.

spells.name: Forge Call
spells._: Self-cast so the tester just casts it on themselves — no target needed. Wraps MFSE_TriggerEffect.

quests.name: Forge Call Target
quests._: Started by the SM ScriptEvent root when MFSE_MagicKW fires. Caster alias pulls event ref1 (the player who cast Forge Call). Verify in-game: cast the spell, then `sqv MFSE_MagicTarget` -> State Running, Caster alias filled with the player.
